name: Crow
source:
This is the current form of the demon Taranis, who can freely create countless chimeras and wield inexhaustible military power. In the demon world he is known as the "Inexhaustible One" and feared even by his own kind, but after his magical powers began to weaken for some reason, he became angry and changed his name to Crow. He plans to recover his magical powers through the "Ritual of Corruption" and regain even more power than he once had.

"Trying to destroy me is foolish. I will punish you with shame and fear worse than death."
